clue.text: Host improperly served moonshine

indicators.note: something done improperly is done wrongly, so the four letters of the word Host are set out in a different order

explanation.surface: A host has illegally served home-distilled liquor to his guests.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moonshine' suggests bootleg whisky, but here it is its other sense of nonsense; 'served' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Moonshine in the sense of foolish talk is a synonym of nonsense or rubbish.

clue.text: Trains on time, delivering box of gunpowder, say

explanation.surface: Trains run on schedule, carrying a crate of explosive.
explanation.walkthrough: Gunpowder is a kind of green tea, rolled into pellets, not an explosive here.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden crate for shipping tea leaves would hold gunpowder, which is a variety of Chinese green tea.

clue.text: Suppress alien that's crossed line

clue.text: Irritability about religious teacher coming to a head

explanation.walkthrough: 'coming to a head' reads as reaching a crisis, but 'coming to' is a link and 'a head' is NESS, a headland as in Loch Ness or Sheerness.
explanation.definitionFit: Crabbiness is bad temper, a synonym for irritability.

clue.text: Freshly decorated, using colour I had

clue.text: Statistical diagrams daily needed in hospital

clue.text: Looking into incomplete relic guarded by one of the locals

clue.text: Minister and I take seats to make a comeback?

clue.text: I combined with XI as part of MCC

clue.text: Work by Rembrandt, for instance, that nobody else could have done
